name: Muck Mátyás — second son named András (b. 1881)
researcher_question: Did Mátyás Muck and his first wife Erzsébet Wolf of Bikács, Tolna, Hungary have a second son named András, baptized about 1881, after their first son András died in infancy in 1873?
notes: Record-hint fixture (filtered-list-samples.csv row 19, flag adds_son, confidence 3). Resolved: true match — the hint record (ARK 1:1:VJRW-GQR/GQY, entry #44, Hungary Reformed Church Christenings) names father Mátyás Muck (farmer) and mother Erzsébet Farkas (= Wolf), a second son András born 19 Oct 1881 (baptized 22 Oct), Bikács. The collection's index metadata gets the year right (1881) but the place wrong (says Bogyiszló, the parish seat, not Bikács) — confirmed by reading the record image directly and cross-checking the full page/scribe's handwriting. A date correction to 1887 was tried mid-adjudication and reverted; it did not hold up against a full page read.
